name: Wise Travel India Ltd.
summary: Wise Travel India Ltd., also known as WTI Cabs, is a prominent player in the Indian business-to-business (B2B) transport solutions sector, specializing in corporate mobility. The company provides a comprehensive suite of services, including corporate car rentals, end-to-end employee transportation solutions (ETS), and luxury coach rentals. These services cater to a diverse clientele of multinational corporations and domestic enterprises across India, with a presence in over 250 cities, and an expanding international footprint in Dubai and London. The corporate car rental services include chauffeur-driven cabs for airport transfers, conferences, intra-city travel, and long-term or daily rentals. Employee transportation services encompass daily home-to-office and office-to-home pick-up and drop services, often managed with on-site coordinators and integrated technology. The company also offers project-based mobility solutions and event transportation services for corporate gatherings. Wise Travel India operates primarily on a B2B model, securing long-term contracts and leveraging a technology-driven asset-light approach, utilizing a proprietary application for real-time tracking, automated billing, and optimized routing. The company is also committed to sustainable mobility, increasing the share of electric vehicles in its operational fleet. Its industry focus is primarily on passenger transportation and ground services within the broader travel and tourism sector.
